title: MysticRealm - Archivist
description: 📚 Summon the Archivist using bookshelves! Fight his endless swarm of flying books for random Enchanted Book drops. Defeat him for 25 XP levels and a relic to summon your own loyal book protectors! ✨🔮
body:
![main](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02f63be86add5e8f086c722df9262695bcb6eb0f.png)

# 📚 MysticRealm: Archivist by Anoosh 📚

Uncover the forbidden knowledge of the ultimate library guardian! **MysticRealm: Archivist** introduces a unique, summonable mini-boss into Minecraft. He doesn't fight you directly; instead, he commands a flying army of magical books to protect his secrets. If you are strong enough to survive his endless library assault, rare enchantments and loyal protectors await you!

---

## ✨ Features

* **🏗️ Custom Summoning Ritual:** The Archivist cannot be found naturally in the world. You must build him yourself! Place **2 Bookshelves vertically** and top them with a **Carved Pumpkin** (just like a Snow Golem) to bring him to life.

![pumpi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85b83ee144ecef6ef947b8ac157a7983225c1b89_0.webp)


* **📖 Flying Book Minions:** The Archivist is peaceful on his own, but his protectors won't hesitate to eliminate you. He summons aggressive, flying magical books that swarm and attack you. Beware: every time you strike the Archivist, he instantly spawns **2 more minions**!

![book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b9934c1e594aa8c599cd5e7ef21390f348a3f70_0.webp)
![sa](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea1c6977785ed5cdcf7e4c06bd8f2a4c0017e2b4.png)

* **🔮 Random Enchanted Drops:** Defeating his flying book minions has a huge reward. They drop **Enchanted Books** with completely random enchantments—ranging from simple utility to high-tier legendary spells!

![wa](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dd327eee9bb1155741d8fcb9027ee1242a8e5dd.png)

* **🏆 Archive Success:** Conquering the guardian unlocks the exclusive **"Archive some books" Advancement**, rewarding you instantly with **25 Levels of XP**!

![advans](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f61b562d818538f57ad546ade67ac3588560f5e2_0.webp)


* **✝️ The Enchanting Cross (Legendary Loot):** Upon defeat, the Archivist drops his sacred **Enchanting Cross**. Hold this powerful relic to summon your very own **Green Flying Book Minions** that will follow you and fight to protect you from enemies!

![cross](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b87ae1e5bb1173f8a08c5075cb37d24f7dd7784_0.webp)

![aaa](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22f473003bef0c11ceb36a5f3c689469ba184eec_0.webp)
---

## 🛠️ Installation & Support
1. Download and install the required library mod (see below).
2. Download the correct version of **MysticRealm: Archivist** for your Mod Loader (Forge/Fabric/NeoForge).
3. Drop both `.jar` files into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4. Gather some bookshelves and a pumpkin, and prepare for a magical battle!

---

## ⛔ Requirements (🚨 REQUIRED DEPENDENCY 🚨)

To ensure the custom animations of the Archivist, his floating books, and the magical relic work flawlessly without any crashes, you **MUST** install the following dependency:

* **[GeckoLib on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib)**
* **[GeckoLib on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/versions)**

*Note: Please ensure you download the version of GeckoLib that exactly matches your game version and mod loader!*
